nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract, set at construction and reassigned during ownership claim.
Address nominated as the next contract owner, cleared after claiming.
Public token symbol string declared in ERC20Interface.
Constant success result code (1) in Object.
Constant error result code (8) returned when caller is not the contract owner.
Mapping of authorized caller contracts in MultiEventsHistory.
Constructor of Owned that assigns msg.sender as the initial contractOwner.
Owner-only function that destroys the contract via suicide(msg.sender).
Owner-only function that nominates a new pending contract owner address.
Finalizes ownership transfer if msg.sender equals the pending owner.
Owner-only function that sweeps ERC20 balances held by the contract to a destination address.
Internal constant helper returning OK if msg.sender is the contract owner, else the denial code.
Owner-only function granting authorization to a caller contract.
Owner-only function revoking authorization from a caller contract.
Fallback function that delegatecalls back into an authorized caller with forwarded msg.data.
msg.sender used in the Owned constructor to initialize contractOwner.
msg.sender compared against pendingContractOwner in claimContractOwnership.
msg.sender used as the key into isAuthorized in the fallback function.
msg.sender compared against contractOwner for the owner modifier/gate checks.
suicide/delegatecall-capable self-destruct sending balance to msg.sender, guarded only by owner check.
msg.sender.delegatecall(msg.data) in the fallback; executes arbitrary untrusted code in this contract's context.
External ERC20Interface(token).transfer call sending a computed balance to an arbitrary destination.
_to parameter of changeContractOwnership, the proposed new pending owner.
_to parameter of withdrawnTokens, the destination of swept token balances.
tokens array parameter of withdrawnTokens listing ERC20 contracts to sweep.
_caller parameter of authorize, the contract address being authorized.
_caller parameter of reject, the contract address whose authorization is removed.
Local address token taken from the tokens array inside the withdrawal loop.
Local balance returned by balanceOf(this) for the iterated token.
Loop index over the tokens array in withdrawnTokens.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into contractOwner during construction, making the deployer the initial owner.
The Owned constructor performs the state write to contractOwner.
msg.sender verified against contractOwner flows into suicide(msg.sender), so owner identity governs the destructive operation.
destroy() invokes suicide, a privileged destructive operation gated solely by the owner modifier.
The onlyContractOwner modifier checks msg.sender before destroy() body execution.
The _to argument is stored into pendingContractOwner for the two-step ownership handover.
changeContractOwnership consumes the _to parameter in its ownership nomination logic.
msg.sender is compared with pendingContractOwner to authenticate the claiming caller.
msg.sender's submitted claim assigns contractOwner from pendingContractOwner.
claimContractOwnership writes the contractOwner state variable.
Elements of the tokens parameter are loaded into the local token variable.
The locally resolved token address is the target of the external transfer call.
The _to parameter is used as the receiver in the external token transfer.
The computed balance local is the amount passed to the external transfer.
withdrawnTokens drives the external ERC20 transfer inside its loop.
The loop index i bounds iteration over the tokens array parameter.
The _caller parameter is written into the isAuthorized mapping, granting contract authorization.
authorize() mutates the isAuthorized access-control mapping.
The _caller parameter is deleted from the isAuthorized mapping, revoking access.
reject() mutates the isAuthorized access-control mapping.
msg.sender is used as the key into isAuthorized in the fallback gate check.
The fallback executes delegatecall into msg.sender after the authorization check, enabling recursive re-entry.
The delegatecall invokes untrusted callee code that can re-enter the fallback, a recursive call path.
checkOnlyContractOwner reads contractOwner to compare with msg.sender.
The internal owner-check helper performs a read-based access decision on contractOwner.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to is only used within changeContractOwnership to set pendingContractOwner, so it normalizes into that function.
Parameter _to is only consumed as the transfer destination inside withdrawnTokens.
Parameter tokens is only iterated inside withdrawnTokens and has no independent role.
Parameter _caller is only consumed to mutate isAuthorized inside authorize.
Parameter _caller is only consumed to delete from isAuthorized inside reject.
Local token merely carries the target address for the external transfer unsafe operation.
Local balance only exists to be the amount argument of the external transfer call.
Loop counter i is scoped entirely to the withdrawal loop in withdrawnTokens.
